senses.gloss: , prob. to be read: קְלִירַרְכוֹס m. (κλήραρχος) president of a district (higher than the epitropos, and subordinate to the decurio, a member of the senate in provincial municipalities). Mekh. B’shall., Amalek, s. 2; Yalk. Deut. 813 פליריכוס, פלירכוס, prob. פּוֹלְיַרְכוֹס (πολίαρχος = prefectus urbi).
